name: Saved desktop layouts
author: aishag80g-stack
description: Restore your favorite desktop from the keyboard: one hotkey launches your apps and places every window at its saved size. A layout per workspace.

barWidget.description: Your ideal desktop shouldn't be a ritual of opening, dragging and resizing every app by hand — every single time. Save your favorite arrangement once, from a screenshot or your live desktop, then bring it back without touching the mouse: bind a hotkey (or one click on the bar, if you like) and missing apps launch on their own, every window lands exactly where you placed it, at exactly the size you set. Keep a saved layout for each thing you do — work, study, gaming — and switch your whole desktop with a keystroke, not ten minutes.
